provenance.sampling_exception: Only the Session::responses_metadata sampling hunk is selected; unrelated CwdRelativeTurnDiffs changes are excluded.
provenance.attestation: New test-only fixture patch from observed bidirectional RPC ordering; no donor pass claimed.

resulting_behavior: WebSocket connection compatibility omits only prewarm kind and root-turn correlation. Durable recovery identity and request-body metadata remain distinct.

Captured resolved authentication binds both reuse equality and the actual upgrade. Default providers compare all captured headers; stable AgentAssertion identity replaces only volatile Authorization proof while retaining credential, account, user, runtime, routing and task boundaries.

Attestation fixture services requests immediately while awaiting both a typed successful turn/start response and turn/completed. Duplicate success or matching RPC error fails; the original successful token envelope and one-handshake assertions remain.

Bedrock protocol endpoints call existing guarded methods. Failed SDK credential resolution returns before config writes; writable user command authentication is removed in the same validated edit, and another layer supplying command authentication is rejected.
